canonical.title: IT conferences & tech events in Paris (2026)

parent.title: A Paris weekend, anchored on one Michelin dinner

siblings.title: Things to do in Paris
siblings.summary: A two-day Paris weekend built around one Michelin-starred dinner: which landmarks to prioritise in 2026, the half-day day-trip that wins in late May, pre- and post-dinner pairings, and the 2026 logistics that have changed.

siblings.title: Michelin 2 and 3-star restaurants in Paris
siblings.summary: Nine three-star tables in Paris for 2026 plus the notable two-stars worth booking — chef, neighborhood, price band, weekend availability, what to expect.

sources.title: VivaTech
sources.claim: VivaTech 2026 takes place June 17–20, 2026 — 10th anniversary edition, Europe's largest tech & startup show.

sources.title: EU Biz — VivaTech Paris 2026
sources.claim: VivaTech is held at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles and is Europe's largest tech innovation and startup show.

sources.title: Devoxx France
sources.claim: Devoxx France 2026 (14th edition) runs April 22–24, 2026, at Palais des Congrès Porte Maillot — Europe's largest independent dev conference.

sources.title: Numérique 360 — Devoxx France 2026
sources.claim: Devoxx France 2026: 240 presentations over 3 days, ~4,600 attendees, talks in French and English.

sources.title: Android Makers by droidcon
sources.claim: Android Makers by droidcon takes place 9–10 April 2026 in Paris.

sources.title: Conference Index — Android Makers
sources.claim: Android Makers by droidcon is held 9–10 April 2026 in Paris.

sources.title: React Paris
sources.claim: React Paris 2026 (3rd edition) runs March 26–27, 2026, in person at Pullman Paris Montparnasse and online.

sources.title: Ticket Tailor — React Paris
sources.claim: React Paris 2026 is held at Pullman Paris Montparnasse, March 26-27, 2026.

sources.title: Paris Blockchain Week
sources.claim: Paris Blockchain Week 2026 runs April 15–16, 2026, at Carrousel du Louvre.

sources.title: Chainwire — PBW 2026
sources.claim: Paris Blockchain Week 2026 opens with an invitation-only VIP dinner at Château de Versailles on April 14, 2026.

sources.title: dotAI
sources.claim: dotAI is the Paris-based AI conference for engineers held at Folies Bergère.

sources.title: dotJS
sources.claim: dotJS is the Paris JavaScript conference held at Folies Bergère.

sources.title: Createwith — dotAI Paris
sources.claim: dotAI 2026 is scheduled September 17, 2026 in Paris; dotJS the day after.

sources.title: Big Data & AI Paris
sources.claim: Big Data & AI Paris 2026 runs September 15–16, 2026 at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles.

sources.title: 10times — Big Data Paris
sources.claim: Big Data & AI Paris 2026 targets ~15,000 visitors with 180 exhibitors at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles.

sources.title: apidays Paris
sources.claim: apidays Paris 2026 runs December 1–3, 2026; theme is the sovereign autonomous API stack and agentic AI.

sources.title: Tradefairdates — Tech Show Paris
sources.claim: Tech Show Paris 2026 is held November 18–19, 2026 at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles.

sources.title: Showsbee — Tech Show Paris 2026
sources.claim: Tech Show Paris bundles five events: Cloud Expo Europe, Cloud & Cyber Security Expo, Data & AI Leaders Summit Paris, Data Centre World, and DevOps Live.

sources.title: 10times — Paris Web
sources.claim: Paris Web 2026 runs September 24–26, 2026 — two conference days plus workshop day, held at INSEP.

sources.title: Paris Web — Appel
sources.claim: Paris Web 2026 issues its call for proposals on its official appel.paris-web.fr site.

sources.title: AI Tinkerers Paris
sources.claim: AI Tinkerers Paris hosts technical AI evenings — next session focuses on Conversational DevOps & AI Infrastructure on May 21, 2026.

sources.title: GOSIM Paris 2026
sources.claim: GOSIM Paris 2026 runs May 4–6, 2026 at Station F — open source agentic AI conference with workshops and hackathons.

sources.title: ai-PULSE
sources.claim: ai-PULSE 2026 is a one-day AI conference on October 13, 2026 at Station F, Paris.

sources.title: Bleap — Paris tech events 2026
sources.claim: The Paris 2026 tech calendar headline events include VivaTech, Paris Blockchain Week, Big Data & AI Paris, Tech Show Paris, dotAI, dotJS, React Paris, Devoxx France, API Days, and AndroidMakers.

sources.title: JDS — VivaTech Paris 2026
sources.claim: VivaTech 2026 is the 10th edition and the major annual French tech fair.

sources.title: Station F — Events
sources.claim: Station F (the world's largest startup campus) hosts ongoing tech events including evenings on May 27-28 and June 1-2, 2026.

sources.title: leHACK
sources.claim: leHACK 2026 runs June 26–28, 2026 at Cité des sciences in Paris — community-oriented spiritual successor to Hack in Paris.

sources.title: ANSSI — leHACK 2026
sources.claim: France's national cybersecurity agency ANSSI lists leHACK 2026 at Cité des Sciences, June 26-28, 2026.
